d: Working across the globe, V2X builds smart solutions designed to integrate physical and digital infrastructure from base to battlefield. We bring 120 years of successful mission support to improve security, streamline logistics, and enhance readiness. Aligned around a shared purpose, our $4.5B company and 16,000 people work alongside our clients, here and abroad, to tackle their most complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism.

The Plumber assembles install and repairs pipes, fittings and fixtures of heating, water, and drainage systems and include cutting and threading pipe, assembling and installing valves, pipe fittings, and pipes composed of metals, such as iron, steel, brass and lead, and nonmetals, and conducting tests to identify leaks. Installs and repairs plumbing fixtures, such as sinks, commodes, showers, water heaters, and repairs and maintains plumbing by replacing washers in leaky faucets, mending burst pipes, and opening clogged drains, and may weld holding fixtures to steel structural members. In addition to the plumbing duties, the plumber will also be responsible for escorting the subcontract workers, buses, and trucks to various locations.
q: Plumbing Journeyman license through any U.S State.
Must possess driver’s license with at least 1 year of remaining validity and ability to drive a Standard Transmission vehicle.
Must possess a US Passport with at least 6 months of remaining validity.
Must be able to obtain Common Access Card (CAC)
Must have communication skills in English, both written and oral.
Good verbal and written communication skills to direct employees, prepare reports for upper management and facilitate/disseminate information.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment requires handling multiple tasks at a given time.
Able to utilize computer automated systems to perform assigned duties.

r: Responsible for performing all assigned duties as safely and efficiently as possible to maintain a safe work environment.
Maintains, installs and repairs all aspects of plumbing including, but not limited to, fire suppression, pool operations and maintenance, water, gas, and sanitary/storm sewer systems.
Modifies, repairs, replaces and maintains component parts.
Able to read and interpret Work Orders, parts requests, drawings/schematics/blueprints and manuals in order to accomplish assigned duties.
Accomplishes periodic inspections, recurring maintenance requirements and associated documentation. Maintains systems to conform to written guidance and applicable changes.
Maintains required operating forms and records and ensures proper use of all assigned shop equipment. Responsible for on-the-job training as required.
Schedules work and perform quality assurance through job site visits.
Responsible for escorting the subcontract workers, buses, and trucks to various locations.
Performs other duties as assigned in accordance with contractual, functional and mission requirements.

d: We are looking for a retail Sales Executive with background in Interior Design for a luxury and premium furniture showroom in Muscat, Oman. The successful candidate should be able to enhance customer satisfaction and meet sales goals. The candidate for this position shall excel at creating and closing new opportunities. By using a consultative approach to selling, this person shall use their expertise to identify and qualify leads, leading to sales opportunities with both new and existing customers.
Higher Diploma degree or higher in Business Administration, Marketing, Interior Design / Architecture or equivalent.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in business, marketing, and administration.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Proficiency in English and Arabic (spoken and written).
Strong communication and behavioral skills, flexibility, and an outspoken approach.
Preferred skills in Canvas and indesign
r: -Support the customers in making the correct choice and build loyalty by providing a personalized and tailored sales experience to each individual prospective customer.
-Maintain professionalism to customers' enquiries about products, prices, availability, and other information related to the items.
-Successfully create business from new and existing customer accounts
-Build rapport and establish long term relationships with customers
-Performing the purchasing process of the items from selecting the furniture, coordinating with the designers, suppliers and the management team.
-Monitor customer trends and provide recommendations to management.
-Prepare quotations, invoices, purchase orders along with terms and condition documents and receipt.
-Promote showroom products outdoor at potential customers locations.

-Engage with suppliers to gain brand knowledge, product specifications and communicate with them on a regular basis regarding the sales, new products, price list, discounts, marketing materials, purchase order, delivery notes, invoices, payments etc.
-Work with the design and installation site team to ensure the client’s requirements are met.
-Coordinating with the marketing and promotion agency and software company for social media, digital marketing, website updates, branding, ERP system etc.
-Maintain knowledge of sales, promotions, products, delivery and store policies.
-Monitor and report the inventory on a regular basis.
-Report daily activities to the Management team.
-Coordinating with the logistics and inspection companies for successful and accurate delivery.
-Supervise the furniture installation and assembly party.
-Continuously researching and establishing a relationship with potential suppliers.
-Travel to meet suppliers and attend furniture fairs.
-Host visiting suppliers or customer from arrival till departure including arranging accommodation, hospitality, meetings, business lunch and dinner, and local transportation.
-Sales & interior design experienced in premium/luxury sector for at least 5 years.
-Experience and working knowledge of CRM systems
-Well versed with the suppliers agreements terms & conditions.
-Basic knowledge of accounting and finance principles for handling liabilities, receivables, billing, payments and preparing of reports.
-Knowledge of understanding technical drawings, supplier technical catalogue and supplier price book and software.
-Experience with Microsoft Office suite, such as: Outlook, Word, excel, PowerPoint.
-Knowledgeable about premium & luxury retail industry (really well).
-Must be good in closing assigned actions satisfactorily.
-Flexible to work overtime and during holidays if needed on compensation basis.
-Strong written and verbal communication skills and behavioral skills, flexibility & outspoken approach.
